item.title: Adolescence Star Owen Cooper Becomes Youngest Golden Globe Winner in Supporting Actor
item.description: GUWAHATI: “Adolescence” breakout star Owen Cooper won his first Golden Globe on Sunday, taking home the award for best male actor in a supporting role on television. At just 16, Cooper became the youngest-ever winner in this category, surpassing Chris Colfer, who was 20 when he won for Glee in 2010. item.title: Newly Discovered Frog Species Named After Late Mayali Journalist As a Tribute
item.description: GUWAHATI: Two new frog species have been identified in Arunachal Pradesh, and one of them has been named as a heartfelt tribute to a veteran Malayali journalist. The discoveries were announced in the international journal PeerJ, following extensive fieldwork and genetic analysis in the Eastern Himalayas. item.description: GUWAHATI: Chief Justice of India Justice Surya Kant on Sunday, January 11, laid the foundation stone for the new Gauhati High Court complex at Amingaon in North Guwahati, even as members of the Gauhati High Court Bar Association continued their protest against the proposed relocation of the court. item.title: Old Age Homes in Guwahati Keep Magh Bihu Alive in Their Own Way
item.description: On a cold Uruka evening in Guwahati, the courtyard of an old age home quietly comes alive. A kettle whistles near the kitchen, someone laughs while arranging firewood for the bonfire, and a faint smell of til pitha drifts through the corridor. Inside, elderly women who once cooked grand feasts for their own families now wait for the fire to be lit, hoping the warmth will make the festival feel a little more like home. item.title: What Magh Bihu Looks Like for Gen Z Today
item.description: Magh Bihu, the harvest festival of Assam, continues to hold a quiet warmth even for Gen Z, a generation growing up between tradition and change. item.description: While Assam marks the end of the harvest season with Magh Bihu, much of Northeast India celebrates similar agrarian milestones during this period. item.title: Magh Bihu 2026: Essential Grocery Prices Surge in Guwahati Markets
item.description: As Magh Bihu, also known as Bhogali Bihu, the harvest festival celebrated with feasts and community gatherings, draws near, residents across Guwahati are confronting an unwelcome accompaniment to the season’s cheer: sharply rising prices of essential groceries. From sesame seeds (til) to mustard oil, rice to sugar and milk, inflationary pressures are shaping up to make this year’s celebration both memorable and costly for consumers. item.description: GUWAHATI: Samar Hazarika, a well-known singer from Assam and the younger brother of legendary musician Dr Bhupen Hazarika, passed away in Guwahati on Tuesday, January 13 at his residence in Guwahati.
